title: oxalis spiralis subsp. vulcanicola
intro: Oxalis spiralis subsp. vulcanicola, commonly known as the volcanic wood sorrel, is a rare and endangered species of flowering plant in the wood sorrel family (Oxalidaceae). This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions are thought to be due to its ability to stimulate immune function, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer effects, likely resulting from its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
